title: Exotic Sri Lanka | Couple Special
highlights: Observe elephant care at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and enjoy a cultural evening in Kandy with the Kandyan Dance.
Explore Kandy's highlights including the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and Royal Botanical Gardens.
Experience Nuwara Eliya's charm with visits to Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, and Hakgala Botanical Gardens.
Visit Mirrissa Beach and enjoy complimentary water rides including banana boat rides and tube rides.
overview:
About the Tour:
An aura full of charismatic charm, ethereal beaches, a playful parade of elephants, historical places, incredible train rides, lush tea estates, and mesmerizing landscapes, Sri Lanka is a country that is on the bucket list of all travelers. From surfing at the thrilling waves, and relaxing at the pristine beaches to taking scenic train trails and getting playful with the elephants, Sri Lanka is definitely a real jewel!
Embark on this exotic vacation by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watch the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways on your way to Kandy. Peek into some of the tea estates and welcome the fresh aroma of the tea and herbs in the rolling green hills offering breathtaking views in Nuwara Eliya. Absorb the laid-back culture of Mirissa - a sunny beach town offering great waves for surfing, and waters teeming with marine life, from turtles to big blue whales. Spend the day enjoying the crystal blue water, snorkeling among incredible marine life (make sure to keep your eyes peeled for turtles!), and enjoying every moment of this slice of heaven. Capture a glimpse of the sky changing its colors and allowing you spectacular views over the ocean through the many leaning palm trees.

know_before_you_go: The above mentioned rates for the package are valid for the Indian Nationals only.
All entry tickets for stupas, monasteries, sightseeing, state and entry fees, jeep safari, boat rides, monument entrances, camera charges, permits, etc. are not a part of the package.
Early check in & late checkout prices are not a part of the package.

All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package. (Please visit www.eta.gov.lk for more details / submit your individual visa application)
The above rates would vary and won't be the same on special days such as Diwali, Dussehra, Christmas and New Years.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.

Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests, hotel change, etc., before the beginning of the trip.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange the itinerary due to any kind of disturbance that occurred (i.e weather condition, political condition, or any others) without changing the total number of days and without compromising any service.
GST is applicable to the package cost.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

If in case any traveler wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from that point onwards will be borne by the traveler. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
Children below 2 years of age will be considered as infants only. Children above 2 years till 12 years of age will be considered and charged as children.
One complimentary water bottle (500ml) each person each day.
Buffet Breakfast from Day 2 to Day 8 and Buffet Dinner from Day 1 to Day 7.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy
days.desc: Upon arrival, board the transfer from the airport and proceed towards Kandy. Enroute visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage. Once you reach, check-in and relax. Later, get assisted to a scenic upper lake drive followed by a Kandyan Dance performance. Get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis
Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show on a Private basis

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Board your transfer from the hotel for a Kandy sightseeing tour and visit places like the Royal Botanical Gardens, Huluganga waterfalls, Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, and more. After the tour ends, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Arrival in Nuwara Eliya | Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred to the hotel in Nuwara Eliya for check-in. Then, board the transfer for a city sightseeing tour. Visit attractions like Hanuman Temple, Ramboda Falls, Seetha Amman Kovil, Hakgala Botanical Gardens, etc. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at Super Deluxe hotel
items.hotel: Oak Ray Tea Bush, Nuwara Eliya

items.title: Full Day Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Bentota
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred to Bentota. Upon arrival at the hotel, check-in and relax. You can self-explore the city by visiting places like Cinnamon Island, Ambalangoda, Brief Garden, and more. Later, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Madu River and Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery Visit
days.desc: Get transferred from the hotel for a visit to the scenic Madu river where you can enjoy a boat ride. Later, visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery and have close encounters with baby turtles. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Bentota Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Excursion to Mirissa
days.desc: Get transferred for Mirissa beach via Galle fort wherein you can visit National Maritime Museum, Meera Mosque, and many more. At the beach, admire Parrot Rock formation, whale-watching (early morning show) and Coconut Tree Hill. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Excursion to Mirissa on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred to Colombo. Upon arrival, check-in and get assisted for a sightseeing tour of the city. Explore places like Lotus Tower, Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, Pettah Floating Market, and many more. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After breakfast, get transferred to the airport to board your flight back home. This is where your trip ends.
